title: Runway Template
description: A Runway template describes a deployable group of services. Templates compile to Runway app shells via the platform's internal API.

apiVersion.description: API version of the template format.

kind.description: Resource kind. Always 'Template' for this schema.

inputs.description: User-supplied inputs collected at deploy time. Keys must be valid identifiers.

name.description: Unique template identifier. Lowercase, hyphen-separated, 2-63 chars.

version.description: Template version. Recommended: SemVer. The first deploy of a new version triggers update notifications for existing instances.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the marketplace UI.

description.description: Short description shown in the marketplace. Markdown not supported here.

logo.description: Path to the logo file relative to the template directory. SVG preferred, PNG accepted.

source.description: Link to the upstream source repository.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the upstream software (e.g. 'MIT', 'AGPL-3.0').

maintainer.description: Maintainer of this template (not the upstream software). Email or GitHub handle.

type.description: Input value type. Complex types are not supported in v1alpha1.

description.description: Help text shown next to the input field in the deploy UI.

default.description: Default value. Must match 'type' (enforced). Presence implies 'required: false' unless overridden.

required.description: If true, the user must provide a value before deploy.

secret.description: If true, the value is stored encrypted, masked in logs, and rendered as a password field in the UI.

enum.description: Restrict the value to one of these options. UI renders as a dropdown. Only valid for type=string or type=integer.

pattern.description: Regex the value must match (type=string only). RE2 syntax.

category.description: UI hint. Inputs in the same category may be grouped and offered platform shortcuts (e.g. 'Create a Postgres add-on to fill these in').

name.description: Service name. Becomes the Kubernetes namespace and Service name. Must be a valid DNS-1123 label.

image.description: Container image reference. Must be digest-pinned (image@sha256:...) for production templates.

command.description: Override the image's ENTRYPOINT. Equivalent to Kubernetes' container.command.

args.description: Override the image's CMD. Equivalent to Kubernetes' container.args.

env.description: Environment variables for the main container. Keys must be valid env var identifiers (uppercase, underscores). Init containers and workers inherit these by default.

init.description: Containers that run to completion before the main container starts. Run sequentially, in array order.

workers.description: Long-running sidecar containers in the same pod. Share the volume and env of the parent service.

^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$.description: Value made available to other services as ${{ ServiceName.OUTPUT }}. May reference env vars and platform variables.

minPlan.description: Minimum plan SKU required for this service's app. Values match the platform's plan SKU (e.g. 'start-m-launch'). The platform validates the user's plan before deploy and prompts an upgrade if insufficient.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: literal string or interpolation. Equivalent to { value: <string> }.

value.description: The value. May contain ${VAR}, ${{ inputs.X }}, ${{ services.Y.Z }}, ${secret(N)}, and ${RUNWAY_*} interpolations.

description.description: Shown in the platform's config UI next to this variable.

warning.description: Shown to the user when they attempt to change this value. Use for footguns like encryption keys whose loss is unrecoverable.

mountPath.description: Absolute path inside the container where the volume is mounted.

volume.description: Declares that this service requires persistent storage. Size is determined by the user's plan, not the template. Implies the service deploys as a StatefulSet.

name.description: Container name. Unique within the service.

image.description: Container image. Defaults to the parent service's image.

env.description: Additional env vars. Merged on top of the parent service's env. Keys defined here override parent values for this container only.

image.description: Defaults to the parent service's image.

type.description: Probe type. 'tcp' is sufficient for most templates and is inferred from the PORT env var. Specify 'http' or 'exec' only when needed.

path.description: Path for HTTP health check (type=http only).

command.description: Command for exec health check (type=exec only). Returns 0 = healthy.

healthcheck.description: Health check configuration. If omitted, the platform infers a TCP probe against the PORT env var.
